scope: All181 unique Live GPS Test frames; all may be used for demo fitting, never independent test
method: Manual source/context review of model-free stereo proposals. Every component assigned rock, hardware or unknown; flat proposals approved with exclusions. Stereo labels are geometric weak supervision, not certified physical ground truth. RGB-only unreviewed proposal points are not accepted automatically.
